text: Where InspirationMeets Design Where Craftsmanship Meets Efficiency Staircase design, manufacture, supply, and installation — partnering with builders, designers, and architects across Queensland, New South Wales, and Victoria for four decades. Move to explore Model of the featured completed staircase The StairMaster Difference Built on Partnership,Delivered with Precision We work with volume builders, bespoke builders, designers, and architects. From a straight flight through to complex geometric designs, curved stairs, and curved balustrading — if it's a staircase, we build it. 01 Innovators We stay current with design trends and materials — timber, glass, steel, and mixed media. Our range evolves because the projects we work on keep evolving. 02 Experienced Decades of accumulated knowledge across design, manufacture, and installation. Our people know staircases inside out — and it shows on site. 03 Responsive Manufacturing across four sites in three states means local knowledge and production resilience. If one site is affected, the others keep producing. Your programme stays on track. What We Have Built to Produce Timber CNC routers across three factory locations — including two 5-axis machines. CNC lathes, moulders, semi-automatic laminating presses, and the full range of production saws and sanders you'd expect. We hold approximately 900 cubic metres of furniture-grade timber at any time to ensure continuity of supply. Metal Our own in-house metal workshop with welding, metal CNC, and powder coating. Balustrading, posts, and custom metalwork produced under the same roof — not farmed out. Glass We supply and install glass balustrading as part of the complete staircase package. Glass panels are sourced from specialist manufacturers to specification. Production Resilience Four factory sites across three states. If one site is affected, the others keep producing. Your programme stays on track. Track Record Approximately 100,000 staircases designed, manufactured, and delivered — both supply-and-install and supply-only — across Queensland, New South Wales, and Victoria. People Our management team carries over 150 years of combined service — four of them completed their apprenticeships with us. We've trained a number of second-generation apprentices, with more on the way. People stay because the work matters. Project Showcase Our Work A selection from across our range. Tread Profiles Closed rise, open rise, and custom profiles in various thicknesses. Standard, sawtooth, and plant-on nosing configurations. Available in paint, carpet and stain grade. View full range Handrails, Bottomrails, and Capping Profiles including pencil round, monorail, bullnose, Victorian, and Ladies Waist. Plus custom dowels, cappings, and vertical grabrails. Matte black and silver. View full range Timber Balusters Standard dressed profiles through to turned and fluted feature designs. Model 1 Our Process Design to Delivery,Handled A clear process from first conversation to final install, designed to fit your programme. 01 Consult & Design We work from your plans and specifications to develop the staircase design. Where needed, our team can provide 3D renders for your review and client approval. 02 Site Measure & Confirm Precise site measurements to ensure the design translates to reality. All dimensions, finishes, and specifications confirmed before manufacture. 03 Manufacture Built in our own facilities by experienced tradespeople. Quality checked at every stage. 04 Deliver & Install Scheduled to your programme. Our installation teams work cleanly and efficiently.
